extraction.name: RoboFAC dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse dataset of robotic failures covering robotic tasks of varying complexity in both simulated and real-world environments, labeled with multi-dimensional information comprising eight question types and totaling 78K video-question-answer (QA) pairs.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Simulation data was collected in the ManiSkill environment with augmented objects and scenes, generating erroneous trajectories via code snippets. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: ManiSkill environment, YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, AI2-THOR, and real-world teleoperation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with textual descriptions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Reference answers for five question types were directly extracted from textual descriptions. For the remaining three types, GPT-4o was used to generate reference answers based on the video and textual description, followed by manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating multimodal large models for robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction.

name.evidence: Firstly, we construct RoboFAC dataset comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments.

description.evidence: we first construct a large-scale and diverse dataset of robotic failures ( RoboFAC dataset ) covering robotic tasks of varying complexity in both simulated and real-world environments... rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We collect the simuluation data for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment... Data collection is performed via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We collect the simuluation data for 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment [25], augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset [26] to increase object diversity and scenes from ReplicaCAD [27] and AI2-THOR [28] to enrich environmental diversity.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: we manually performed thorough data cleaning and retained approximately 75% of the collected data.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: For five question types— task identification ,task planning ,failure detection ,failure identification , and failure locating —the reference answers can be directly extracted from the corresponding textual description... For the remaining three types— failure explanation ,high-level correction , and low-level correction —we utilize both the video and its corresponding textual description as inputs to GPT-4o to generate the reference answers... To ensure annotation quality, all outputs from GPT-4o were manually reviewed and corrected.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: we utilize both the video and its corresponding textual description as inputs to GPT-4o to generate the reference answers.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Although we have demonstrated that the RoboFAC model’s correction suggestions can effectively assist the VLA model in recovering from failures, our current integration of the model into the VLA-controlled robotic system is not yet seamless.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Leveraging the RoboFAC dataset, we build a multimodal large model ( RoboFAC model ) capable of performing robotic task understanding, failure analysis, and failure correction based on robot video.
